structured.feedback: The description is Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action, and it stays under 300 words (about 280, well above the "around 200" target). It leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws: the feature/benefit split is loose, "wet and dry hair" and "without stripping natural oils" aren't supported by the listing, and "At 16 oz, this 16-ounce bottle" is redundant.
